notes_for_editor: Story is about 75 words, below the 120-word floor, because the only tower-specific source is one undated-in-content list row. Searches (two per tower) and cache checks (NHLR, firetower.org, eastern and central US lookout lists, Vanishing Georgia) found no history, staffing or fate for this site. Do not treat the list's 'archer' note as a fact; the list does not explain it. The list gives elevation 431 with no unit; the record's 131.4 m assumes feet. A 2013 Forest Fire Lookout Association newsletter (firelookout.org cr-rp-gasc-2013.pdf) says a Georgia tower status list was being compiled, which is a lead for a Georgia Forestry Commission records request. Human review recommended before publishing as a history.
